data.body: Milestone: RED-first tests added in tests/unit/test_gate_ref_hash_basis.py. RED evidence: initial run failed because both unresolvable-ref and materialization-failure arms logged the same generic 'current gate-ref snapshot unavailable' message. Implementation split resolve_ref and cache.acquire handling; targeted tests plus tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_ref_coherence.py now pass (11 passed). Sandboxed mutation removing the resolved-SHA materialization wording made the held-out materialization test fail, then implementation was restored.
